newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks close lower on quiet afternoon trade.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks close lower on quiet afternoon trade.

text.p: Shares ended Wednesday lower as investors stuck to the sidelines, waiting to see when the market would recover from its correction period, brokers said.
The composite stock index fell 7.24 points to provisionally close at 811.98. Declining shares beat advancers 572 to 305.

"Profit-taking is still hitting those stocks that soared in recent weeks," said a Dongsuh Securities broker. "I think for the time being we'll see the index moving in a box range between 800 and 840, with a lot of fluctuation."
Volume was on the decline, reflecting the wait-and-see stance of most investors.
